question: Is attainment on the ground or near the navel-lake equally fruitful in this context?
premises: Attainment on the ground is considered
Attainment near the navel-lake is considered as alternative
Fruitfulness is affirmed in that locus
inference: The result is fruitful even when obtained near the navel-lake.
uncertainties: The symbolic meaning of nābhī-sarasa is uncertain
plain_english: Whether on the ground or obtained near the navel-lake, it is fruitful.
